is_mentioned_in_leaks.description: True if you are confident the queried company genuinely appears in a leak dataset

entities_found.description: Entities judged to be plausible matches for the queried company

dataset.description: e.g. Panama Papers, Pandora Papers, Paradise Papers, Bahamas Leaks, Offshore Leaks

match.description: True if the API considers this a confident match

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of findings, or confirmation that no matches were found
